OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The hunt platform the connector executes against.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_SECURITY_PLATFORM_NAME.description: Name of the OpenCTI Security Platform the hunts are executed against.

CONNECTOR_SECURITY_PLATFORM_TYPE.description: Type of the OpenCTI Security Platform the hunts are executed against.

CONNECTOR_MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS.description: Maximum number of hunt runs OpenCTI may dispatch to this connector at the same time. The platform budget is the minimum of its own setting and this value.

CONNECTOR_OBSERVABLE_TYPES.description: Observable types the connector may create from hunt results, intersected with the types expected by each hunt. Defaults to IOC types only; supported values: IPv4-Addr, IPv6-Addr, Domain-Name, Url, StixFile, Email-Addr, Hostname, User-Account, Mac-Addr.

CONNECTOR_MAX_OBSERVABLES.description: Maximum number of observables created per hunt run (the most frequent first).

SPLUNK_HUNT_URL.description: URL of the Splunk REST API (management port), e.g. 'https://splunk.example.com:8089'.

SPLUNK_HUNT_TOKEN.description: Splunk authentication token (preferred). Leave empty to use username and password.

SPLUNK_HUNT_USERNAME.description: Splunk user name, used when no token is set.

SPLUNK_HUNT_PASSWORD.description: Splunk user password, used when no token is set.

SPLUNK_HUNT_VERIFY_SSL.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate of the Splunk REST API.

SPLUNK_HUNT_APP.description: Splunk app namespace the search jobs run in.

SPLUNK_HUNT_OWNER.description: Splunk user namespace the search jobs run in.

SPLUNK_HUNT_SEARCH_PREFIX.description: SPL constraint added to every search, e.g. 'index=wineventlog OR index=sysmon', or the '`opencti_hunt_scope`' macro of the OpenCTI for Splunk Enterprise add-on.

SPLUNK_HUNT_SIGMA_PIPELINE.description: pySigma pipeline(s) translating Sigma rules, chained with '+': 'splunk_windows', 'splunk_sysmon_acceleration', 'splunk_cim' or 'none'.

SPLUNK_HUNT_OUTPUT_FORMAT.description: pySigma Splunk output format: plain searches ('default') or CIM data model searches ('data_model', requires the 'splunk_cim' pipeline).

SPLUNK_HUNT_POLL_INTERVAL.description: Seconds between two status checks of a search job.
